info.title: US Federal Contracts & SAM.gov Procurement B2G Radar
info.description:
Extracts and audits official U.S. Federal Government contract awards via USAspending.gov v2 and SAM.gov APIs (Zero-Key required). Scores B2G vendor competitiveness (0-100), tracks DoD/HHS/VA awards, and generates Markdown procurement briefs.

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (US Federal Contracts & SAM.gov Procurement B2G Radar)
- **Target B2B Buyers:** U.S. Federal Defense Contractors, GovCon BD Teams, and Public Sector Market Intelligence Platforms.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`U.S. Federal Contract Award & B2G Audited`).
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Business` | Zyla API Hub `Government & Legal`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** sam-gov, usaspending, federal-contracts, govcon-intelligence, naics-psc, b2g-procurement, defense-contracts.

x-code-snippets.Python:
import httpx

url = "https://b2b-quant-rapidapi-gateway.jesleytassili.workers.dev/v1/us-sam-gov-federal-procurement-auditor"
payload = {
    "keyword": "cybersecurity",
    "awardingAgency": "",
    "minAwardAmount": 50000,
    "maxResults": 5
}
headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "X-RapidAPI-Host": "us-sam-gov-federal-procurement-auditor.p.rapidapi.com",
    "X-RapidAPI-Key": "<YOUR_RAPIDAPI_OR_ZYLA_KEY>",
}

with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
    response = client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.json())

UsSamGovFederalProcurementAuditorRequest.title: US Federal Contracts & SAM.gov Procurement B2G Radar Request Schema
UsSamGovFederalProcurementAuditorRequest.description: Configure contract scope keyword, federal awarding agency filter, minimum award value in USD, and maximum results to extract and score U.S. Federal Government B2G contracts.

keyword.title: Contract Scope / Technology Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword searched in federal contract award descriptions (e.g., 'cybersecurity', 'cloud software', 'medical supplies', 'autonomous').

awardingAgency.title: Federal Awarding Agency (Optional)
awardingAgency.description: Optional filter by top-tier U.S. Federal Agency name (e.g., 'Department of Defense', 'Department of Veterans Affairs').

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum Contract Value (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Minimum contract obligation amount in USD (0 to 1,000,000,000).

maxResults.title: Maximum Contracts to Extract
maxResults.description: Maximum number of federal contract awards to extract and score (1 to 100).
